content.text: What You Can Actually Get Done Today

You can establish a digital storefront that accepts international payments through cryptocurrency in an afternoon. Start by setting up a Cloudflare Pages account for hosting your content. Next, integrate a backend with Cloudflare Workers, which will handle your payment logic seamlessly. By utilizing NOWPayments for crypto transactions, you will be able to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal fees and no buyer account requirements. This is your pathway to bypassing the limitations imposed by traditional payment processors.
The Minimum Viable Stack That Works

The Sovereign Starter Stack is your go-to solution for a quick deployment. For just $97, you will receive all the tools needed to create an effective online store. This includes GitHub Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script for handling backend logic, and NOWPayments for processing transactions. The entire stack can be deployed within 48 hours, allowing you to start selling your digital products quickly while retaining full ownership and control over your data and sales.
Skipping the Steps That Do Not Matter Yet

Focus on what drives immediate results rather than getting bogged down in unnecessary complexities. Avoid diving into advanced integrations or customizations at the outset. Instead, prioritize the essential components: a clean storefront, a reliable payment processor, and direct access to your digital files. By minimizing distractions and executing these straightforward steps, you ensure that you can get live transactions flowing without delay.
Blockchain payments eliminate geographic barriers to commerce.
Getting Your First Transaction Live

To facilitate your first transaction, ensure that you have added products to your store and configured appropriate payment options through NOWPayments. Test the entire process by purchasing your own product to confirm that everything functions smoothly. Utilize USDT on the Tron network, which settles in under 60 seconds for fees below $0.10, making it an ideal choice for swift transactions. This will not only validate your setup but also give you confidence in the efficiency of your payment process.
What to Do in the Next 24 Hours

In the next 24 hours, finalize your product listings and begin marketing them through social media channels. Create engaging posts to attract potential buyers while ensuring your payment setup is tested thoroughly. Utilize the resources available in the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all six blueprints and seven templates to streamline your deployment and scaling efforts. This is a crucial investment to enhance your digital commerce capabilities and ensure a smooth operational flow.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

Creators in Africa can sell digital products to international buyers by leveraging blockchain technology and cryptocurrency payment processors like NOWPayments. This approach bypasses traditional banking limitations and allows for seamless transactions across borders. Creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Zimbabwe, and other restricted markets searching for international payment solutions are looking for the same thing: a way to receive USD-equivalent payments from global buyers without a Stripe or PayPal account. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete answer — Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments deployed under your accounts in 48 hours. For creators who want to self-deploy, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 covers both stack options with full source code and step-by-step configuration guides. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Set up a Cloudflare Pages account for hosting your storefront. Integrate Cloudflare Workers to manage backend processes. Add products to your store for sale. Register with NOWPayments to facilitate cryptocurrency transactions. Test your payment process by making a purchase yourself. Promote your digital products through social media channels to attract buyers. Utilize the Complete Builder Kit to optimize your store's performance.
Frequently Asked Questions
What cryptocurrencies can I accept?

NOWPayments allows you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, including popular options like Bitcoin, Ethereum, and USDT. This flexibility enables you to cater to a diverse international audience and select currencies that suit your market needs.
How long does it take to set up my store?

By using the Sovereign Starter Stack, you can have your online store up and running within 48 hours. This rapid deployment ensures you can start selling your digital products without unnecessary delays.

NOWPayments charges a nominal fee of 0.5% per transaction, making it an economical choice for processing payments. Additionally, using networks like TRON ensures transaction fees remain under $0.10, further enhancing your profitability.
Can I sell my products internationally?

Yes, the infrastructure you deploy allows for international sales. With blockchain payments, you can transact with buyers anywhere in the world without being restricted by traditional banking systems.
